title: Whole-ship mass does not reach the 4,426 t benchmark
mechanism: Magnet, protection and radiator mass raise dry mass; eta 0.86 and canon delta-v set the mass ratio
assumptions: Canon jet power and four 4,797 km/s burns; REBCO 1.53e8 A/m2
solutions: Higher Je tape (9,820 t at 6e8), lighter supports, eta toward 0.95, mission-level trade (owner)
advances: Conductor Je >= 6e8 A/m2 at 20 K with 3e22 n/m2 tolerance

title: Field-ripple heating of the winding and eddy shield
mechanism: 20 kHz pulses couple a field ripple dB/B ~ eps_c E/(2W) into the winding; Bean AC loss and eddy heating
achieved: W eddy shield 2.35 MW/m2 at 2,642 K bare (held at 2,300 K with fins); unshielded winding 10 MW at 20 K
severity: HIGH: at eps_c 1 the shield does not close
solutions: Pulse shaping, flux-conserving inner shell, larger W/E ratio, segmented eddy shield
next: Plasma-coupled pulse simulation (resistive MHD) for eps_c

title: Plasma-coupled detachment not modelled
mechanism: Exhaust must detach from closed field lines; only vacuum test particles were pushed
required: eta and forward leakage from a coupled model
severity: HIGH: eta and the cant could move either way
solutions: Hybrid PIC or two-fluid detachment model
next: 2D hybrid detachment run for B today

title: Rare high-energy strikes on hardware unbounded
mechanism: Zero hits in 40,960 test particles bounds the hit share only at 2.9e-4 (about 17 GW)

title: Winding neutron fluence sets a 15 m ring floor
mechanism: REBCO limit 3e22 n/m2; below R about 15 m no nose length closes; the nose tip takes about 100 dpa per mission
achieved: Closes at R >= 15 m; tip 9.9e26 n/m2
assumptions: W-B4C attenuation length 0.08 m; scattered floor 1e-4
advances: Conductor tolerance 3e23 n/m2 would allow R ~ 10 m

title: Neutrons reach the ship through the plug
mechanism: The plug skin removes 10 % of neutrons; 2.59 GW for four engines at the RON point
achieved: Met with a LiH shadow slug (6 t/engine at B today, 77 t at the RON point)
next: Coupled n-gamma transport of plug and slug

title: Forward escape needs cant; E cannot clear its forward stream
mechanism: Loss-cone escapers intercept ship, plug and booms; E needs > 30 deg
required: Ship <= 0.1 GW, plug and booms <= 0.3 GW
achieved: B: 0-0.5 deg at S 770 m; E: not cleared at 30 deg

title: Exhaust plume cannot stop dust (Mode B)
mechanism: Plume column at the ship 1e-9 to 4e-11 kg/m2 against 0.045 kg/m2 to stop a 2.6 kJ grain

title: HIMS: deflection limited by plasma beta and the ionised share, not by the field integral
mechanism: Isolated ions turn in 0.01 T over 20 m (Si14+ gyroradius 0.3 m at 0.3 T); the dense debris cloud is super-Alfvenic until it fills 4 mu0 E / B^2; neutrals (10-30 %) pass
required: Lower stern protection mass than passive
achieved: C 0.3 T: 543 t vs 41 t passive (NOMINAL); 598 t vs 100 t (JUSTIFIED)
assumptions: Full ionisation at ~120 keV/u (EXTRAPOLATED); cone 30 deg (NOMINAL), 15 deg (JUSTIFIED)
severity: MEDIUM: HIMS costs more than it saves
solutions: Field only where stand-off is constrained; high-Je magnets (mass /4); superconducting field from existing bus
next: Hybrid PIC of a debris plasmoid entering a 0.3 T field

title: Vertex ring fields cannot reach the dust path at the ship
mechanism: Ring far field at the stern path 3.3e-6 T; Si14+ gyroradius 30 km

title: Laser pre-ionisation of dust
mechanism: Illuminating the stern path to vaporise the design grain in its 0.2 ms transit needs 1.9e11 W/m2

title: Engine faces cannot have a screen ahead of them
mechanism: Any screen ahead of a ring or plug face sits in the burn view (5e8 W/m2 face-on) or in the exhaust
achieved: 0 m: monolithic C/C armour 8-19 cm (195 t NOMINAL, 700 t JUSTIFIED)
next: Armour shape study at the nose

title: Boom service ducts dominate JUSTIFIED dust mass
mechanism: Lateral booms present 2 x 2,083 m2 of duct; fences need 155-215 m stand-off in JUSTIFIED, so armour (1,580 t)
solutions: Redundant cables (relax the critical criterion), cryoplant at the engine (power only)
next: Redundancy criterion; C2 bus deflector rejected (1,860 t)

title: Stern screen erosion and replacement
mechanism: Perforating grains hole 0.55 % (NOMINAL) to 2 % (JUSTIFIED) of the screen; erosion 13-120 um
required: Screen holds through each braking burn

title: Impact physics above 100 km/s is extrapolated
mechanism: No laboratory data for grains at 4,800 km/s; cone angle, ionised share and wall rules are extrapolated
advances: Accelerator or laser-driven microparticle tests at 100-1,000 km/s

title: Engine-to-engine magnetic forces on the boom frame
mechanism: Ring dipoles repel: 106 kN per pair at S 400 m (RON), 1.7 MN at E 250 m; asymmetric on a quench
achieved: Small at B today (R 15 m, S 770 m)

title: Giga-cycle fatigue from the 20 kHz ripple
mechanism: Ripple stress 51 MPa at 4.8e11 cycles; Goodman 0.28 on extrapolated CFRP data

title: Quench protection of thin tapes
mechanism: Copper hot-spot limit shortens the dump: 8 sections at 5 kV (today), 36 (advanced), 165-239 (speculative)

title: Adaptive geometry adds mass without protection
mechanism: Carriage and locks 25 t/engine, +292 t departure; braking needs no field change
